topic: jev-weighted documentation refresh sweeps: the process spec for triaging a documentation corpus with a decision model, digging with a self-hosted metasearch, weighting results, and landing cited updates

subtopics.scope: Enumerating every file in the corpus and computing cheap per-file staleness signals (filename age, size, title, section presence) that feed triage.
seed_queries: documentation corpus staleness metrics file metadata age

subtopics.scope: Scoring every doc with a typesafe decision model (jev-1.13 via POST /api/decide) using batched, paced requests and typed answers.
seed_queries: LLM as judge triage scoring documents pipeline
structured decision model API yes no probability classification

subtopics.scope: Blending the decision score with normalized age into a ranked refresh queue, bounded to a small dig set.
seed_queries: blended ranking score recency weighting formula
backlog prioritization stale documentation refresh queue

subtopics.scope: Digging with self-hosted searXNG reached through an n8n webhook proxy: transport, query design, top-N keeping, and the thin-dig redo rule.
seed_queries: n8n webhook proxy internal service API gateway

subtopics.scope: Weighting every collected result with the noul metric so only decision-model-scored sources can back claims.
seed_queries: evaluating source authority primary sources aggregators
LLM relevance scoring search results quality filter

subtopics.scope: Persisting signals, verdicts, digs, and weights as a typed, append-only, versioned dataset that travels with the PR.
seed_queries: research provenance dataset schema JSON logging
typed dataset TypeScript interfaces documentation data

subtopics.scope: Turning weighted results into doc updates where every claim carries its source URL and weight; unverifiable claims are deleted, thin digs are skipped.
seed_queries: citation grounded writing source URL claim verification
AI generated documentation accuracy citation requirements

subtopics.scope: Landing the sweep as one draft PR with a fixed-format body and post-push verification so the evidence chain is reviewable in isolation.
seed_queries: draft pull request reviewable isolated branch verification
content repo PR review checklist data files
